groups: Taṇhaṃkaro nāma jino puretvā dasa pāramī
The Conqueror named Tanhankara, having fulfilled the ten perfections,
Jetvā mārāri saṃgāmaṃ buddhattaṃ samupāgame
defeated the enemy Mara in battle and attained Buddhahood.
Etena sacca vajjena (pilakā rogo) (te) vinassatu
By the speaking of this truth, may your cancer be destroyed.
Etena sacca vajjena sabbe rogā (te) vinassantu jayasiddhi bhavantu (te)
By the speaking of this truth, may all your diseases be destroyed, and may you be blessed with triumphant success.

Aṭṭha vīsati ime buddhā
These twenty-eight Buddhas,
Pūretvā dasa pāramī
having fulfilled the ten perfections
Jetvā mārāri saṃgāmaṃ
and having conquered the enemy Mara in battle,
Budadhattaṃ samupāgamuṃ
attained Supreme Buddhahood.

Tesaṃ saccena sīlena
By the power of their truth and virtue,
Khantimetta balena ca
and by the power of their patience and loving-kindness,
Tepi(tvaṃ) anurakkhantu
may they protect you,
Ārogyena sukhena ca
with good health and happiness.
